    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p><a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/us-men-s-national-team/" >United States</a> head coach Mauricio Pochettino has named his 26-man roster for the 2026 <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/competitions/fifa-world-cup/" >FIFA World Cup</a>, calling up <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/every-mls-player-usmnt-world-cup-roster-2026-fifa-usa" >eight MLS players</a> for the momentous tournament on home soil.</p>

    </div>
  
              </div>
              <div class="body-part d3-l-col__col-12">
                

    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <h3>GOALKEEPERS (3)</h3>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <ul>
<li><strong>Chris Brady - Chicago Fire FC</strong></li>
<li><strong>Matt Freese - New York City FC</strong></li>
<li><strong>Matt Turner - New England Revolution</strong></li>
</ul>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <h3>DEFENDERS (10)</h3>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <ul>
<li><strong>Max Arfsten - Columbus Crew</strong></li>
<li>Sergiño Dest - PSV</li>
<li>Alex Freeman - Villarreal</li>
<li>Mark McKenzie - Toulouse</li>
<li><strong>Tim Ream - Charlotte FC</strong></li>
<li>Chris Richards - Crystal Palace</li>
<li>Antonee Robinson - Fulham</li>
<li><strong>Miles Robinson - FC Cincinnati</strong></li>
<li>Joe Scally - Borussia Mönchengladbach</li>
<li>Auston Trusty - Celtic</li>
</ul>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <h3>MIDFIELDERS (6)</h3>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <ul>
<li>Tyler Adams - AFC Bournemouth</li>
<li><strong>Sebastian Berhalter - Vancouver Whitecaps FC</strong></li>

<li>Malik Tillman - Bayer Leverkusen</li>
</ul>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <h3>FORWARDS (7)</h3>

      <p><em>MLS call-ups are bolded above.</em></p>

              </div>              <div class="body-part d3-l-col__col-12">
                

    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <h3>USA schedule: Group D</h3>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <ul>
<li><strong>June 12:</strong> USA vs. Paraguay, 9 pm ET | Los Angeles, California</li>
<li><strong>June 19:</strong> USA vs. Australia, 3 pm ET | Seattle, Washington</li>
<li><strong>June 25:</strong> USA vs. Türkiye, 10 pm ET | Los Angeles, California</li>
</ul>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>The 2026 World Cup has expanded from the usual 32 nations to 48 total. The top two teams advance from each group, and the top eight third-place finishers also make the knockout phase (Round of 32).</p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>The tournament, which is co-hosted by the United States, Mexico and Canada, spans from June 11 to July 19.</p>

    </div>
  
              </div>
              <div class="body-part d3-l-col__col-12">
                

    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <h3>MLS call-ups</h3>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>All three goalkeepers feature in MLS, with <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/players/matt-freese/" >Matt Freese</a> (<a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/new-york-city-football-club/" >NYCFC</a>) and <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/players/matt-turner/" >Matt Turner</a> (<a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/new-england-revolution/" >New England</a>) likely vying for the starting role. <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/players/chris-brady/" >Chris Brady</a> (<a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/chicago-fire-fc/" >Chicago</a>) rounds out the trio. </p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p><a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/players/maximilian-arfsten/" >Max Arfsten</a> (<a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/columbus-crew/" >Columbus</a>) adds pace and creativity out wide, while center backs <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/players/tim-ream/" >Tim Ream</a> (<a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/charlotte-fc/" >Charlotte</a>) and <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/players/miles-robinson/" >Miles Robinson</a> (<a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/fc-cincinnati/" >Cincinnati</a>) have combined to play nearly 120 times for the USMNT.</p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p><a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/players/sebastian-berhalter" >Sebastian Berhalter</a> (<a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/vancouver-whitecaps-fc/" >Vancouver</a>) and <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/players/cristian-roldan/" >Cristian Roldan</a> (<a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/seattle-sounders-fc/" >Seattle</a>), both of whom made the <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/2025-mls-best-xi" >2025 MLS Best XI</a>, bring experience to the midfield.</p>

    </div>
  
              </div>
              <div class="body-part d3-l-col__col-12">
                

    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <h3>MLS alums</h3>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>The squad features <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/aaronson-to-zendejas-every-mls-export-on-usmnt-2026-world-cup-roster-squad-usa" >nine MLS homegrown products</a> currently playing abroad, plus another four who developed in MLS academies before heading to Europe.</p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>Brenden Aaronson, Mark McKenzie and Auston Trusty are former <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/philadelphia-union/" >Philadelphia Union</a> homegrown stars. </p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>Chris Richards, Ricardo Pepi and Alex Zendejas broke through as <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/fc-dallas/" >FC Dallas</a> homegrowns.</p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>Tyler Adams did the same with <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/red-bull-new-york/" >Red Bull New York</a>, Alex Freeman rose to stardom at <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/orlando-city-sc/" >Orlando City</a>, and Joe Scally was one of NYCFC's first homegrown signings.</p>

    </div>
  
              </div>
              <div class="body-part d3-l-col__col-12">
                

    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <h3>MLS stats</h3>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <ul>
<li>Eight players compete in MLS for eight different clubs, amounting to 31% of Pochettino's team.</li>
<li>Of the 26 players named, another 13 (50%) are either MLS homegrown products or players who spent time in an MLS academy.</li>
<li>Combined, those 21 players account for 81% of the USMNT's World Cup squad.</li>
</ul>

    </div>
  
              </div>
              <div class="body-part d3-l-col__col-12">
                

    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <h3>World Cup history</h3>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>This will be the USMNT's 12th World Cup appearance and first under Pochettino, who managed some of Europe's top clubs before taking over in September 2024.</p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>In the modern era, the Yanks' best-ever World Cup finish came in 2002. They made the quarterfinals before losing to Germany.</p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>This is the second time the United States have hosted the men's World Cup. The previous instance came in 1994, helping lay the groundwork for MLS's inaugural season in 1996.</p>

    </div>
